verses.text: Wherefore, henceforth live we no more after the flesh; yea, though we once lived after the flesh, yet since we have known Christ, now henceforth live we no more after the flesh.

title: JST, 2 Corinthians 5:16. Compare 2 Corinthians 5:16 Paul counsels Saints not to live after the manner of the flesh.
